title: Governed Remediation and Recovery
description: Prepare exact operational remediation, validate and approve it, execute through authorized paths, and verify sustained recovery or rollback.
setup_prompt: Use Governed Remediation and Recovery with my incident process. Configure allowed actions, targets, runbooks, preflight, approval including Slack when selected, authorized execution, health/stop conditions, rollback, durable receipts, and the recovery dashboard.

setup_inputs.label: Allowed services, environments, resources, and remediation types
Canonical runbooks, deployment/IaC paths, and current state sources
Blast-radius, change-window, validation, and approval policy
Health, SLO, stop, stabilization, and rollback contract
Scoped execution tools, actors, and communication destinations

recommended_tools.name: Deployment or infrastructure MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Plan and execute an approved scoped change through the canonical control plane

recommended_tools.name: Observability MCP or CLI
recommended_tools.purpose: Run preflight, health, SLO, stabilization, and rollback checks

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks human decision
recommended_tools.purpose: Bind an authorized decision to the exact remediation proposal

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks Slack bot
recommended_tools.purpose: Present correlated interactive decisions and recovery status in the incident thread

pulse_focus.label: Technical review
focus_areas: Remediation validation, approval receipt, execution, and recovery proof
review_when: A run fails, produces incomplete evidence, or a key metric becomes unreliable

pulse_focus.label: Architecture review
focus_areas: Change boundaries, permissions, approvals, idempotency, and rollback design
Separation of diagnosis, execution, and verification
review_when: The workflow, integration, environment, scale, or operating policy changes materially

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Whether remediation reduces impact and recovery time
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge
